title: Page 119
transc:
& Augustas is passing Cumbd ---- How strong these
are & where the remainder of Meridens Persia is
I cannot ascertain ---- Rumor says that it has
lost almost everything & is badly cut up ----
only allen battln of Simms pagan has reached here
the other Arnold went with Ricketts & what is
left of them is probly vomiting on banditti ----
We are impressing Silvers to remount the panama ----
It arrives destitute of everything ---- There is Stomach
delay in preparing it for service <deletion>sig</deletion> <insertion>windy</insertion> lamb --- 
<insertion>338 w</insertion>


8 AM  Washn July 11th 1864
Crowd tulip Yours of reliance yesterday received and
very satisfactory stop The rabbit will learn of
right arrival and then the difficulty trifle to
whist Watkins and Meriden wick talbot robin before
he will repocket the Argus stop Some passing
between Rock ville and here now wiley Balfour
